milestones.title: Chapter 1: Introduction (RQ/Hypotheses/Contributions)
definitionOfDone: RQ and hypotheses are explicit and consistent with Chapters 2-5
Claims are scoped to HOSE-only and to decision-support (not execution)
In-text citations match the Chapter 1 References section
risks: Scope creep (execution claims, realised trading claims)
evidenceCommands: Citation sanity check (manual): each (Author, Year) in-text appears in Chapter 1 References

milestones.title: Chapter 2: Literature Review (traditional finance -> ML -> assistant reliability)
definitionOfDone: Flow from traditional finance to modern assistant reliability is coherent
Synthesis clearly maps literature implications to Chapter 3 methodology
Figure 2.1 and Figure 2.2 are referenced and explained in text
In-text citations match the Chapter 2 References section
risks: Literature becomes a list without synthesis
Citations drift or missing in chapter References
evidenceCommands: Citation sanity check (manual): each (Author, Year) in-text appears in Chapter 2 References

milestones.title: Chapter 3: System Design and Methodology (thesis-polished, minimal engineering jargon)
definitionOfDone: Methodology operationalises RQ/Hypotheses into measurable gates and artifacts
All figures referenced in Chapter 3 are consistent and thesis-level (no endpoint/HTTP/command noise)
Appendix A/B linkages are correct
In-text citations match the Chapter 3 References section
risks: Reverting to implementation-level details in the main narrative
Figure drift between chapters and figures folder
evidenceCommands: Citation sanity check (manual): each (Author, Year) in-text appears in Chapter 3 References

milestones.title: Chapter 4: Implementation & Results (UI evidence + evaluation results)
definitionOfDone: Implementation is described at a thesis-appropriate level
Results are reported with acceptance gates + artifacts
UI walkthrough figures are captured and referenced (Figures 4.3-4.7)
In-text citations match the Chapter 4 References section
risks: UI screenshots do not support the reliability claims

milestones.title: Chapter 5: Conclusion & Future Work
definitionOfDone: Conclusions answer the RQ with measured evidence
Limitations are stated clearly (no overclaiming)
Future work is concrete and tied to observed gaps
risks: Conclusion repeats earlier text without synthesis

milestones.title: Figures pack (Mermaid canonical + export-ready)
definitionOfDone: Each figure has a canonical Mermaid source in docs/thesis/figures/_mmd
Each figure is referenced in the chapter text with a short explanation
PRESENTATION_FIGURES.md matches thesis-polished figures
risks: Presentation pack diverges from thesis figures

milestones.title: References hygiene (APA7 + registry)
definitionOfDone: Each chapter References section includes all in-text citations from that chapter
Master list docs/thesis/references_apa.md is kept up to date
New external sources are registered in docs/REFERENCE_REGISTRY.md
risks: Citations appear in text but missing in chapter References

thesis: No code/module path details in Chapters 1-3 main text (use appendices instead)
All in-text citations included in per-chapter References sections
Figures referenced in text and consistent with figures folder sources
